description: Server-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11: turns the permanent Soul Speed glitch into a perk that survives relog and dimension changes and is lost only on death.

mods.name: SoulPerk
mods.description: Server-side: turns the orphaned Soul Speed glitch into a persistent perk that survives relog and dimension changes and is lost only on death.

releases.notes:
- Initial release.
- Glitch detection: an orphaned vanilla Soul Speed boost (the boots-swap glitch) is converted into a
  persistent, level-aware perk and vanilla's stuck state is cleaned up.
- Boots-break trigger: Soul Speed boots breaking on your feet while the boost is active grant the
  perk at their exact level.
- The perk survives relog, Nether/End portals and leaving the End; it is lost only on death or by
  command. No stacking with real Soul Speed boots by default.
- Commands: `/soulperk`, `/soulperk messages on|off`, `/soulperk remove`,
  `/soulperk admin give|remove|check|reload`.
- Permission nodes `soulperk.use` (everyone) and `soulperk.admin` (op level 2) through
  fabric-permissions-api (bundled), so LuckPerms works out of the box.
- JSON config (`config/soulperk.json`) with live reload.

**Install:** drop the jar into the server's `mods/` folder next to Fabric API (Fabric Loader 0.18.4+, Minecraft 1.21.11) and restart. Requires Fabric API; LuckPerms optional.
